name: Aries
omens: Aries wants to act now, so the company launched before anyone decided how it should look.
The company races ahead while its image lags behind, and Aries knows the feeling.
Aries burns with impatience: every day without a decent site is a missed chance.
Aries starts faster than it finishes. The brand needs someone to close the details.

name: Taurus
omens: Taurus loves what lasts. The company has looked the same for years, and even Taurus is starting to feel it.
Taurus sticks to the tried and true while clients look for something fresh.
Taurus sees quality in the product but not in how the company shows itself.
Taurus stays calm, though quietly suspects the competition looks better.

name: Gemini
omens: Gemini talks to clients in two voices and neither sounds like the company.
Gemini has a thousand ideas, and the brand still does not know who it is.
The company's message bounces off the walls like an echo in a crypt, and Gemini hears every bounce.
Gemini's duality has leaked into the materials: two logos and three typefaces.

name: Cancer
omens: Cancer keeps the company in a shell, and clients have no idea what is inside.
Cancer feels more than it shows, and the brand hides its best sides too.
Cancer fears change, though a fresh look would do the company good.
Cancer remembers every client, but the company gives them nothing worth remembering.

name: Leo
omens: Leo wants to shine, but nobody spots the company in the crowd.
A lion's pride is not enough. Someone has to design the brand's glow.
Leo roars and clients hear only noise, because the company lacks a striking image.
Leo deserves a crown, and the company is still wearing a borrowed hat.

name: Virgo
omens: Virgo has everything buttoned up, except that clients get lost on the site.
Virgo notices every flaw in the company, so she will notice the one in the site layout too.
Virgo tidies the processes while the company's look has waited in line for years.
Virgo knows what detail is worth, and crooked margins bother her more than they bother the client.

name: Libra
omens: Libra weighs the options for so long that the company still has no final look.
Libra craves harmony, and the company's materials look like they come from different eras.
Libra wants to please everyone, while the brand needs one clear style.
Libra senses something uneven in the company and is right: there is no coherent visual system.

name: Scorpio
omens: Scorpio sees beneath the surface and knows the company's image gives it away.
Scorpio knows the company's secret: its quality is greater than the brand shows.
Scorpio distrusts appearances. So do clients, when a site looks abandoned.
Scorpio senses the competition biting, and the company has no image to defend itself with.

name: Sagittarius
omens: Sagittarius aims high, but the company's site never reaches the client.
Sagittarius seeks adventure while clients seek a clear offer.
Sagittarius shoots in every direction, and the brand needs a single target.
Sagittarius promises a far journey, yet the company has not given clients so much as a map.

name: Capricorn
omens: Capricorn climbs the ladder while the company still looks like a beginner.
Capricorn counts every penny, so the image keeps waiting for a budget.
Capricorn builds for decades. The brand should show it, not just claim it.
Capricorn is serious, yet the company's site speaks in the tone of ten years ago.

name: Aquarius
omens: Aquarius has a vision of the future while the company looks like the past.
Aquarius is ahead of its time, only clients have not noticed yet.
Aquarius prizes originality, so the company should not look like everyone else.
Aquarius tosses ideas into the ether, and the brand has no vessel to catch them.

name: Pisces
omens: Pisces drifts with the current, and the company has no image to point the way.
Pisces senses the clients but cannot describe the company in a single picture.
Pisces dreams, and the company needs someone to draw those dreams.
Pisces drowns in the fog of its own ideas and needs a lighthouse in the form of a clear message.
